+initial Rust wall-clock time must not be used as an attack-cost estimate. Direct process
+measurements confirmed the main implementation difference: RustCrypto `argon2 0.5.3` consumed
+approximately one CPU core while the OpenSSL-backed `cryptography` call used approximately three
+cores on average for the four-lane computation. Broader measurements on representative x86-64 and
+ARM64 systems would be required before these figures could support a portability or deployment
+claim.

+($`t_{\mathrm{eff}} = 24`$) in 111.171 seconds for encryption and 118.975 seconds for decryption,

+container with $`\mathrm{PIM} = 0`$ produced a recovery-verifier mismatch. This single observation
